body.name: v2.3.0
body.body:
### TL;DR

* Symfony 8 support
* API Platfrom 5 support
* Symfony UX 3 support
* [Admin] Dark mode
* [Grid] Core grids configured in PHP
* [Promotion] Rules and actions per channel, usage tracking toggle, comparison operators, optimistic locking
* [Payment] Payment Request is stable
* [Shop] Resend verification email, post-flush cart events, reusable `CartItemAdder`
* [DX] Service and Behat configuration moved from XML/YAML to PHP
* [Maintenance] Removed ProxyManager, Gaufrette and `behat/transliterator`
* Requires PHP 8.3+

body.name: v2.2.9
body.body:
### TL;DR

🔒 This is a security release!

Fixes the following vulnerabilities:

- [Shop API accepts arbitrary PaymentRequest actions, allowing a customer-triggered refund ](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-2rv4-pjmm-7fxf)
- [Order total can be inflated after a gateway transaction has started, marking the order fully paid ](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-vv4h-q2x8-74g4)
- [JWT audience confusion allows shop customer to authenticate as administrator](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-f6mx-qxjc-55xf)
- [Administrator password-reset link is built from the request Host header, allowing reset-token theft ](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-77w3-2367-7xvq)

### Details
* SY-801: Add stripe logo in shop footer by @bartek-sek in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19170
* Remove Dependabot configuration and auto-merge workflow by @GSadee in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19174
* [Composer] Conflict with doctrine/orm 3.6.8 breaking schema generation by @GSadee in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19175
* [BUG] [Admin] [Translation] Wrong german translation for "Select" type in Product Attributes Grid by @crydotsnake in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19178
* Introduce payment methods promotion banner by @GSadee in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19184
* Fix cart offcanvas losing Bootstrap state on live re-render by @marekrzytki in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19187
* SY-799: Add hook for suggested payment methods by @bartek-sek in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19188
* [2.2] Add JwtAudienceListener to enforce JWT audience and principal validation by @TheMilek in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19213
* [2.2][ApiBundle] Restrict PaymentRequest actions allowed from shop context   by @TheMilek in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19214
* [2.2] Fix Host header injection in the admin password-reset e-mail link   by @TheMilek in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19215
* [2.2] Prevent payment amount tampering after a gateway transaction has started  by @TheMilek in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19216


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/compare/v2.2.8...v2.2.9

body.name: v2.3.0-ALPHA.1
body.body:
### TL;DR
- ⚙️  PHP 8.3+ and Symfony 8 support, broadened Doctrine stack (DoctrineBundle 3 / DBAL 4)
- 🧑‍ New PHP grid configuration for all admin and shop grids
- 🌙 Dark mode in the Admin panel
- 🏷️  Per-channel promotion rules & actions: one promotion, independent configuration per channel
- 🏷️  Track usage on cart promotions and comparison operators added to Cart Quantity and Item Total rules
- 🔐 Resend verification email: one-click action on the shop login page + a new shop API endpoint
- 🔐 Admin access levels in the Admin Panel and API
- 💳 Payment Request is no longer experimental
- 💳 Hardened payment data decryption
- 🛒 Post-flush cart events + a reusable CartItemAdder service
